form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether this handler's expression is added to the query when other components on the dashboard have a selection.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: When unticked, the expression below isn't used.

form:FormGroup.label: Additional Query Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: Expression added when other components on the dashboard have a selection. Use selection parameters such as ${{component.table-AB1C2.selection.Name}, which you can insert from Current Selection. If several handlers are enabled, their expressions are combined with OR.

form:FormGroup.label: Current Selection
form:FormGroup.helpText: Parameters and selected values currently available from other components. Use the insert button next to a value to add it to the expression, or the copy button to copy it.
